# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This corpus is overwhelmingly **non-sales operational chatter** — driver/vehicle coordination for transport bookings (Raipur/Nagpur/Vizag trailer brokers), MTC/tag/test-certificate paperwork for site deliveries, payment-release follow-ups, crane/loading logistics, and a large number of garbled or personal/irrelevant calls (e.g., the "Vishal" series, wrong numbers, family chit-chat, an Amazon B2B cold call). Only a modest slice of calls are genuine **sales conversations**: dealer-to-dealer rate negotiations (Tirupati Balasubramaniam), construction-site/contractor steel enquiries (Uniqcore Const, Vinayaga Steel, V R Earth Movers, V Kumar, Vadivel T S, Vidveda, VJR Developers, Vasanth Narasimhan, Vasudevan Ganesan/K, Yuvaraj Elumalai), and a few rate-only enquiry calls (Trans/Royal trailer brokers asking commercial rates, Triway/Pondicherry/Odisha enquiries). Given the heavy dilution with ops/logistics material, this KB is built only from the identifiable sales threads; conclusions should be read as indicative, not exhaustive.

## Products & brand ladder
Based on what customers and the BSC team actually discuss:
- **TMT rebar / TMT rods** — core product; sizes 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 25, 32 mm. Grades discussed: FE500 (often **unavailable** — "500 கிடைக்காது sir… 500D stop பண்ணிட்டாங்களா"), **550D** (the commonly available RINL/Vizag grade), E250 and E350 (E350 carries "₹3000 extra").
- **Conversion/re-rolled TMT ("conversion material")** — a cheaper, non-primary-mill category explicitly distinguished from "normal material" (Tirupati Balasubramaniam calls repeatedly contrast "conversion material rate high" vs normal).
- **MS Plates / HR Plates** — thickness range 2 mm–25+ mm, checkered plates, standard sheet sizes 2500×6300, 2010/2000 widths; "above 10–12 mm thickness ₹1000–2000 extra."
- **Structurals**: ISMB beams, MS channels (ISMC), MS angles, MS flats, MS round bars — all typically quoted in the same ₹65–70/kg band ("ISMB, channel, angle கூட அதே range தான் 65, 66, 67").
- **Build-up/fabricated sections (PEB)** — explicitly **not standard-priced**; BSC tells customers "fabricator தான் check பண்ணி சொல்லுவாரு," i.e., BSC sells raw material only, not engineered PEB packages.
- **Products NOT dealt by BSC** (explicitly stated): SHS/square & rectangular pipe/tube ("SHS நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல sir", "pipes நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல Ma'am… direct-ஆ source பண்ணுவீங்க"), CHS pipe, bolts/hanger bolts/angle bolts ("sale மேக்ல அதெல்லாம் sale வராது").
- **Brands/mills referenced**: Vizag (RINL) — flagship source; SAIL; "main make/Vaisakh" positioned as equivalent to SAIL on price ("Vaisakh-க்கும் sale-க்கும்… ரெண்டுமே same price தான்"); Tata Steel and JSW cited only as competitor benchmarks, not BSC's own brand; NMDC mentioned for plates.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- **16 mm / 12-25 mm TMT (conversion, Vizag)**: ₹68, later re-quoted ₹69, then settled back to ₹68 — "68 ஆக்கா வேணாம் நீங்கள் இப்போது மறுபடியும் 69 போட்டனர்… மறுபடியும் 68 போட்டனர்."
- **8 mm TMT**: ₹71 ("8mm 500 தக்கவு 8mm 71").
- **10 mm TMT**: ₹68–69 depending on day; one call cites "10mm ₹3 increase… 68, and 8mm 69."
- **VJR Developers Vizag quote (single day)**: 16/20/25 mm = ₹65; 12 mm = ₹67; 10 mm = ₹68–69; 8 mm = ₹70; **+ ₹500 extra for Sriperumbudur delivery** vs ex-Vizag price.
- **HR Plate (Uniqcore)**: "₹66 + tax" main make, thickness up to 10–12 mm; beyond that "₹1000–2000 extra." ISMB/channel/angle quoted in the same 65–70 band. MS round ~68–70.
